# Read in Wu et al., 2025 GBM
```{r}
snra.dir <- paste0(output.dir, "snrna/")
oligo.dir <- paste0(output.dir, "snrna/", "oligodendrocytes/")

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", "Wu_2025_GBM/", "GSE274987_gbm_regional_RNA.rds"))

seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, oligo.gene.signatures)
seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, fgf.gene.signatures)

seurat.obj$Region <- factor(seurat.obj$Region, levels = c("TC", "TE", "PT"))
seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% dplyr::mutate(Region.long = case_when(
  Region == "TC" ~ "Tumor core",
  Region == "TE" ~ "Tumor edge",
  Region == "PT" ~ "Peritumoral",
  TRUE ~ NA
))
seurat.obj$Region.long <- factor(seurat.obj$Region.long, levels = c("Tumor core", "Tumor edge", "Peritumoral"))

seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['Pct_mito']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))
```

# OPC to Oligo proportion and reactive oligo expression
```{r}
# 1. Filter the object for only the two classes of interest
sub_obj <- subset(x = seurat.obj, subset = CellClass_L1 %in% c("Oligodendrocyte", "OPC"))
sub_obj <- subset(sub_obj, subset = Platform == "Multiome")

# 2. Extract metadata and calculate proportions
plot_data <- sub_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Region.long, Patient, CellClass_L1) %>%
  tally() %>%
  group_by(Region.long, Patient) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n))

# 3. Create the stacked barplot with labels
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Region.long, y = proportion, fill = CellClass_L1)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  # Add the labels here
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, " (", round(proportion * 100, 1), "%)")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,     # Adjust size as needed
    color = "white", # White often looks better on dark bar colors
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "Relative Proportion", 
    x = "Region", 
    fill = "Cell Type",
    title = "Oligodendrocyte vs. OPC Distribution"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Patient)

# Save the plot
pdf(paste0(snra.dir, "tumor.region_vs_OPC.Oligodendrocyte.proportion.pdf"), width = 18, height = 12)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Region vs reactive.oligo.general and other genes/sigs
```{r}
seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj.oligo, subset = Platform == "Multiome")

unique(seurat.obj.oligo$Platform)

comparisons.use <- list(c("Tumor core", "Tumor edge"), c("Tumor edge", "Peritumoral"), c("Tumor core", "Peritumoral"))
pathways.use <- c("HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING", "KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY", "BIOCARTA_PLC_PATHWAY", "HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING")

sample.df <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Region, Sample) %>%
  summarize(reactive.oligo.general = mean(reactive.oligo.general),
            reactive.oligo.non.tumor = mean(reactive.oligo.non.tumor),
            reactive.oligo.specific = mean(reactive.oligo.specific),
            acute.demyelination = mean(acute.demyelination),
            acute.remyelination = mean(acute.remyelination),
            acute.de.re.myelination = mean(acute.de.re.myelination),
            FGFR1 = mean(FGFR1),
            FGFR2 = mean(FGFR2),
            BCAS1 = mean(BCAS1),
            ENPP6 = mean(ENPP6),
            ASPA = mean(ASPA),
            MBP = mean(MBP),
            MOG = mean(MOG),
            HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING = mean(HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING),
            KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY = mean(KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY),
            BIOCARTA_PLC_PATHWAY = mean(BIOCARTA_PLC_PATHWAY),
            HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING = mean(HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING),
            IFN_DAO = mean(IFN_DAO),
            DAO1 = mean(DAO1),
            DAO2 = mean(DAO2),
            count = n()
            ) %>%
  ungroup()

for (y in c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific", "acute.demyelination", "acute.remyelination", "acute.de.re.myelination", "FGFR1", "FGFR2", "BCAS1", "ENPP6", "MBP", "ASPA", "MOG", pathways.use)) {
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific") ~ "Reactive oligodendrocyte signature",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination signature",
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination signature",
    TRUE ~ y
  )
  
  if (y %in% c("MBP", "ASPA", "MOG")) {
    alternative.use <- "less"
  } else {
    alternative.use <- "greater"
  }
  
  if (y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific")) {
    figures.dir <- figure.4.dir
  } else {
    figures.dir <- figure.5.dir
  }
  
  do.boxplot(data = seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, 
             x.variable = "Region",
             y.variable = y,
             output.filepath = paste0(figures.dir, 'wu_2025_GBM_region_vs_', y, '.pdf'),
             ylab.label = paste0(y.title, "\nin oligodendrocytes"),
             comparisons = comparisons.use,
             boxplot.fill.variable = "Region", 
             fill.scale = NULL,
             image.width = 8,
             image.height = 8,
             facet.by = NULL,
             vars.to.regress = NULL,
             alternative = alternative.use,
           )
  
  do.boxplot(data = sample.df, 
             x.variable = "Region",
             y.variable = y,
             output.filepath = paste0(figures.dir, 'wu_2025_GBM_region_vs_', y, '_by_sample.pdf'),
             ylab.label = paste0(y.title, "\nin oligodendrocytes"),
             comparisons = comparisons.use,
             boxplot.fill.variable = "Region", 
             fill.scale = NULL,
             image.width = 8,
             image.height = 8,
             facet.by = NULL,
             vars.to.regress = NULL,
             alternative = alternative.use,
             show.points = T,
             outlier.shape = NA
           )
}
```

```{r}
seurat.obj.oligo <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.oligo, dims = 1:n.dims.use)



# 1. Custom function for upper triangle: Spearman Rho + Raw P-Value
my_spearman <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  # Safely extract variable names as strings using rlang (comes with ggplot2)
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$x)
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(mapping$y)
  
  # Calculate Spearman correlation and p-value
  test <- cor.test(data[[x_name]], data[[y_name]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  
  rho <- round(test$estimate, 3)
  p_val <- test$p.value
  
  # Format p-value: use scientific notation if it's highly significant
  p_text <- format.p.value(p_val)
  
  lbl <- paste0("rho = ", rho, "\n", p_text)
  
  # Find midpoint of data for text placement
  x_mid <- mean(range(data[[x_name]], na.rm = TRUE))
  y_mid <- mean(range(data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    annotate("text", x = x_mid, y = y_mid, label = lbl, size = 4) +
    theme_void()
}

# 2. Custom function for lower triangle (line of best fit only)
my_smooth <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    geom_smooth(method = "auto", color = "blue", ...)
}

# 3. Create the ggpairs plot using your Seurat metadata
p <- ggpairs(
  seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data[vars.of.interest],
  lower = list(continuous = my_smooth),
  upper = list(continuous = my_spearman)
) +
  theme_bw()

# 4. Save to PDF
```

# Region of interest vs genes/signatures
```{r}
seurat.obj.oligo <- seurat.obj.oligo.original
unique(seurat.obj.oligo$Platform)

# region for genes/signatures of interest
genes.of.interest <- c("OLIG2", "SOX10", "CSPG4", "PDGFRA", "BCAS1", "ENPP6", "ASPA", "MBP", "MOG", "FGFR1", "FGFR2")
vars.of.interest <- c(names(oligo.gene.signatures), names(myelination.signatures), names(gene.signatures.gsea), names(fgf.gene.signatures), genes.of.interest)


p <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj.oligo, group.by = "Region", features = vars.of.interest, stack = T, flip = T) + stat_summary(fun = mean, geom='point', size = 15, colour = "blue", shape = 95) + stat_summary(fun = median, geom='point', size = 15, colour = "black", shape = 95) + NoLegend() + ggtitle("Oligodendrocytes")
pdf(paste0(oligo.dir, "tumor.region_vs_reactive.oligo.features_vlnplot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 20)
print(p)
dev.off()



ggplot(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, aes(reactive.oligo.general, BCAS1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  facet_wrap(~Patient + Region)


comparisons <- list(c("Tumor core", "Tumor edge"), c("Tumor core", "Peritumoral"), c("Tumor edge", "Peritumoral"))

for (y in vars.of.interest) {
  
  print(y)
  
  if (y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific", "ENPP6", "BCAS1", "ST6GALNAC3",
               "acute.demyelination", "acute.remyelination", "acute.de.remyelination")) {
    alternative <- "greater"
  } else if (y %in% c("ASPA", "MOG", "MBP")) {
    alternative <- "less"
  } else {
    alternative <- "two.sided"
  }
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific") ~ "Reactive oligodendrocyte signature",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination signature",
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination signature",
    TRUE ~ y
  )
  
  if (y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific")) {
    figures.dir <- figure.4.dir
  } else {
    figures.dir <- figure.5.dir
  }
  
  d <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data
  d$y <- d[[y]]
  
  stat.test <- d %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(y ~ Region, comparisons = comparisons, alternative = alternative) %>%
      rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
      rstatix::add_significance("p.adj") %>%
      rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Region", 
                               step.increase = 0.1,  # INCREASE THIS if they still overlap (e.g., try 0.15)
                               y.trans = function(x) x * 1.0) # Lifts the initial bracket slightly above the highest data point)
  stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)
  
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(Region, .data[[y]], color = Region)) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, color = "grey") +
    
    stat_summary(
      fun = "mean", 
      geom = "point", 
      shape = 18,          # 18 is a diamond shape
      size = 3,            # Adjust size to your liking
      color = "red",   # Distinct color so it doesn't blend into the boxplot
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    xlab("Region") +
    ylab(y.title) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", size = 6) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
    
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "tumor_region_vs_", y, ".pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}


# Keep patients with AT LEAST 2 regions
patients.w.min.two.regions <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(Patient) %>%
  summarize(n.regions = n_distinct(Region)) %>%
  filter(n.regions >= 2) %>%     
  pull(Patient)

for (y in vars.of.interest) {
  
  if (y %in% c("AC009063.2", "KIAA0355")) {
    next
  }
  
  if (y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific", "ENPP6", "BCAS1", "ST6GALNAC3",
               "acute.demyelination", "acute.remyelination", "acute.de.remyelination")) {
    alternative <- "greater"
  } else if (y %in% c("ASPA", "MOG", "MBP")) {
    alternative <- "less"
  } else {
    alternative <- "two.sided"
  }
  
  y.title <- case_when(
    y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific") ~ "Reactive oligodendrocyte signature",
    y == "acute.demyelination" ~ "Demyelination signature",
    y == "acute.de.re.myelination" ~ "Remyelination signature",
    TRUE ~ y
  )
  
  if (y %in% c("reactive.oligo.general", "reactive.oligo.non.tumor", "reactive.oligo.specific")) {
    figures.dir <- figure.4.dir
  } else {
    figures.dir <- figure.5.dir
  }
  
  d <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>% filter(Patient %in% patients.w.min.two.regions)
  d$y <- d[[y]]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIX: Identify and remove patients with zero variance in a region
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  valid.patients <- d %>%
    group_by(Patient, Region) %>%
    # Calculate the variance or number of unique values per region per patient
    summarize(n_unique = n_distinct(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
    # A group must have at least 2 unique values to be statistically testable
    summarize(min_unique_across_regions = min(n_unique), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    filter(min_unique_across_regions >= 2) %>%
    pull(Patient)
  
  # Filter data to only include valid testable patients
  d_filtered <- d %>% filter(Patient %in% valid.patients)
  
  # If no patients survive the filter for this gene, skip to the next gene
  if (nrow(d_filtered) == 0) {
    message(paste("Skipping gene/signature:", y, "- insufficient variance across patient regions."))
    next
  }
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # 1. Compute stats dynamically (using d_filtered instead of d)
  stat.test <- d_filtered %>%
    group_by(Patient) %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(y ~ Region, comparisons = NULL, alternative = alternative) %>%
    rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    rstatix::add_significance("p.adj")
  
  # Note: You were calling add_xy_position twice in your original code. 
  # You only need the second one with your custom step.increase and y.trans.
  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    rstatix::add_xy_position(
      x = "Region", 
      data = d_filtered,            
      formula = y ~ Region, 
      step.increase = 0.1,  
      y.trans = function(x) x * 1.0
    )
  stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)
  
  p <- ggplot(d_filtered, aes(Region, .data[[y]], color = Region)) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, color = "grey") +
    stat_summary(
      fun = "mean", 
      geom = "point", 
      shape = 18,      
      size = 3,            
      color = "red",   
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    xlab("Region") +
    ylab(y.title) +
    facet_wrap(~Patient) + 
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", size = 6) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "by_patient/", "tumor_region_vs_", y, "_by_patient.pdf"), width = 14, height = 10)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```
